Research Question: Can a single 80GB-class GPU perform eight auditable Qwen3-8B LoRA SFT updates on explicitly approved training-only trajectories and reload the resulting adapter consistently?
Hypothesis: Per-turn labels yield finite matching CE, LoRA gradients and parameter changes while frozen parameter samples remain unchanged; save/reload preserves fixed-input logits and greedy output within the declared checks.
Independent Variable: Before versus after eight LoRA optimizer updates; this is an integrity/cost probe, not S1/S2
Metrics: save/reload logit error and greedy output
Evidence Gate: At least two and at most four distinct quality-approved training tasks; all examples fit 8192 without truncation; eight valid updates, matching first-step CE, some changed LoRA parameters, frozen samples unchanged, adapter reload checks passed. Agent success improvement is not claimed by this probe.
Cost Bound: User waived monetary gating on 2026-09-10. Keep one GPU, eight updates, microbatch1, at most 24 per-turn examples and 1800 process seconds. Record unknown price/cost as null.
Failure Branch: Preserve all evidence and stop on provenance/masking/loss/gradient/update/reload or resource failure; do not increase model, context, steps, cards, seeds or automatically enter S1/S2/DPO/RL.
selection_rationale: Two complete quality-approved CRM/PM trajectories;3+5 turns cover8 updates exactly once. Integrity probe only, not a random-versus-targeted SFT comparison.
